title: How the estate of a deceased Muslim is applied

steps.title: Funeral and burial expenses
steps.text: Reasonable expenses, and of the last illness

steps.title: Debts
steps.text: Including the widow's unpaid dower — an unsecured debt

steps.title: Legacies
steps.text: Up to one-third of the remainder; more only with heirs' consent

steps.title: Sharers
steps.text: Twelve Quranic heirs with fixed fractions; aul if they exceed the estate

steps.title: Residuaries
steps.text: Agnates take the residue; if none, radd to sharers (not spouses)

steps.title: Distant kindred
steps.text: Cognates — only if no sharers (other than a spouse) and no residuaries

title: The twelve sharers (Hanafi) — shares at a glance

cards.title: Father
cards.text: 1/6 with child; + residue with daughters only; residuary if no child

cards.title: Mother
cards.text: 1/3 · 1/6 with child or 2+ siblings · 1/3 of remainder (Umariyyatan)

cards.title: Son's daughter
cards.text: 1/2 · 2/3 · 1/6 with one daughter; out by son or 2 daughters

cards.title: Full sister
cards.text: 1/2 · 2/3 · residuary with full brother or with daughters
